Numerical enclosures must justify one posting under the admitted tie rule. Finite and Gaussian updates preserve evidence identity and unresolved mass;continuous inference requires a declared measure. exit_state: The language distinguishes preserved Core0 teaching syntax from proposed portable records and the whole-company typed profile. Exact quantities,unknowns,admission and content identity remain separate. Shared debt symbols preserve the continuous family;posting rules propose checked batches and resolve explicit overrides without hidden priorities. Alternative readings inherit constraints and share treatment choices. The discussion of new evidence and corrected assertions continues next;the compilation cross-reference on page97 is queued for repair.
